_docs: LENS↔FOCUS Feedback Loop — FOCUS writes patterns after each QA session, LENS reads them before generating. This is the learning mechanism that makes prompts get better over time.

focus_to_lens._docs: FOCUS writes this after every QA batch. Tracks recurring failures so LENS avoids repeating them.

engagement_to_lens._docs: Social afternoon agent writes structured performance data here. LENS reads it to adjust visual style allocation.

canvas_to_lens._docs: CANVAS writes designability feedback here. Images that don't work for design get flagged so LENS avoids those compositions.
